rv.q: Matthew Cammelle as Perón and Ben Forster as a touring tango-singer register strongly and Sarah McNicholas as Perón’s discarded mistress delivers her one number, Another Suitcase in Another Hall, with exemplary clarity. If the show still works, it is largely because it boasts one of Lloyd Webber’s best, most tightly composed scores.
For my part, it is the worst production of a musical I have ever seen on a West End stage.
